Class SignRequestParameterUtils

java.lang.Object
se.oidc.nimbus.signrequest.SignRequestParameterUtils
public final class SignRequestParameterUtils extends Object
Utility methods for getting the https://id.oidc.se/param/signRequest parameter from an authentication request. See section 3.1.1 of Signature Extension for OpenID Connect, version 1.2.
Author:
Martin Lindström

  • Method Details

    • getSignRequestJWT

      public static JWT getSignRequestJWT(AuthorizationRequest request) throws ParseException
      Gets the signature request parameter JWT passed as a custom request parameter (section 3.1.1.1).

      The returned JWT is either signed or signed and encrypted. The caller must decrypt it (if needed), verify its signature and claims (see SignRequestClaimsVerifier), and then parse the claims using SignRequestClaimsSet.parse(com.nimbusds.jwt.JWTClaimsSet).

      Parameters:
      request - the authentication request
      Returns:
      the JWT, or null if the request does not contain the parameter
      Throws:
      ParseException - if the parameter value is not a valid JWT, is an unsigned JWT, or if the parameter is given more than once

    • getSignRequest

      public static SignRequest getSignRequest(JWTClaimsSet requestObjectClaims) throws ParseException
      Gets the signature request parameter from the claims of a Request Object (section 3.1.1.2).

      The caller must have verified the Request Object before calling this method.

      Parameters:
      requestObjectClaims - the claims of a verified Request Object
      Returns:
      the sign request, or null if the Request Object does not contain the parameter
      Throws:
      ParseException - if the parameter value is invalid
